description: Use this to create or edit an AI image. Text-to-image from a prompt, OR image-to-image / editing / multi-reference by passing input_images (URLs, data URIs, or base64) — e.g. edit or restyle an image the user just generated by passing its URL. Input support is per-model: some take 1 image, some several, some none (check each model's max_input_images via list_models). Submits an async job and returns a job_id — then call check_generation_status to poll (usually ready in seconds); when complete it returns the finished image inline for you to display. Each call starts a new job that spends credits from the user's BudgetPixel balance (failed jobs aren't charged). Default model: seedream-5.0-pro; call list_models to see every available model with prices and input limits.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. Omit for the default: 1:1 — except an edit with flux-3-image or nano-banana-2.1, which keeps the first input image's shape unless you set a ratio here.

background.description: Optional output background for models that support it (seedream-5.0-flash, seedream-5.0-pro — see list_models). "transparent" keeps a transparent background when EDITING: pass exactly one input image, a PNG that already has transparent pixels (a cutout, sticker or logo), and you get back a PNG with transparency. It cannot make a transparent image from text alone. Omit (or "opaque") for a normal image.

google_search.description: Optional, nano-banana-2.1 only: ground the image in live Google Search results (weather, scores, recent events, current facts). Off by default. Costs extra: 10 credits per image (list_models shows the current price). Turn it on only when the request needs current, real-world information, and tell the user it adds to the cost.

grounding.description: Optional, flux-3-image only: let the model research the prompt with web and image search before rendering. On by default and free. Set false for faster, self-contained generation. Omit for the default.

image_search.description: Optional, nano-banana-2.1 only: let the model look up web images as visual reference before rendering (what a real place, product or landmark looks like). Off by default. It runs a Google Search too, so it costs 20 credits per image in total, with or without google_search (list_models shows the current price). Tell the user it adds to the cost.

input_images.description: Optional input image(s) for image-to-image / editing / multi-reference — each a public image URL, a data URI, or raw base64. Per-model support: some models take 1, some several, some none (see max_input_images in list_models). Omit for text-to-image. To edit an image the user just generated, pass its URL here.

model.description: AI model id. Omit for the default (seedream-5.0-pro — strong identity preservation, good for edits, up to 9 reference images). For fast, low-cost drafts pick flux-2-klein or seedream-5.0-flash (flat 25 credits, free references). By job: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (precise edits), gpt-image-2.5-flare (fast everyday generation), seedream-4.5 (photorealism), gpt-image-2 (text in images), nano-banana-2.1 (fast, sharp text in images, up to 9 free references; optional paid search grounding), nano-banana-2 (editing), qwen-image-3.0 (all-rounder), flux-3-image (FLUX 3: up to 10 free references, optional web grounding; priced by size, 55 credits at 768px up to 790 at 4K). Call list_models for the full catalog with prices and input limits.

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the generated image

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

quality.description: Optional rendering quality for models that support it (gpt-image-2: low/medium/high; gpt-image-2.5-sunburst and gpt-image-2.5-flare: low/medium/high/xhigh/max; grok-imagine-image-2: low/medium — no high tier). Higher costs more. On grok-imagine-image-2 quality x resolution sets the price (low 1K=50, low 2K=80, medium 1K=80, medium 2K=100 credits). Omit for default.

resolution.description: Optional output size (per-model options, e.g. seedream-5.0-pro & seedream-5.0-flash: 1K/2K; gpt-image-2 & nano-banana-2: up to 4K; nano-banana-2.1: 1K/2K/4K; flux-3-image: 768px/1K/1.5K/2K/4K — see list_models for what each size costs). Omit for the model default. Larger costs more, sometimes far more: flux-3-image is 55/65/90/130/790 credits per image at 768px/1K/1.5K/2K/4K, so confirm with the user before choosing 4K.
